newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MISC stock suspended pending news.
newsitem.headline: MISC stock suspended pending news.

text.p: The stock of shipping firm Malaysia International Shipping Corp Bhd (MISC) was suspended from late-Wednesday trading, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said in a statement.
In a circular to its members late on Wednesday, the exchange said the stock was to be suspended four minutes before the close of Wednesday's session.
The exchange attached a letter from MISC which requested for the suspension pending a news announcement.
The company did not give other details.
But according to recent speculation, businessman Mirzan Mahathir of Konsortium Perkapalan is targeting to buy a stake in the national shipper.
Shares of shipping and haulage firm Konsortium and its affiliate Diperdana Corp Bhd remain suspended.
MISC was was last traded on Wednesday at 6.85 ringgit.
